content:
Connor O'Brien: release thread for Usage Insights beta enablement. goal: flip flag + allowlist + comms checklist. Targeting Thurs AM PT unless someone screams.

Paula Mendes: +1. Beta criteria: route+model breakdown tables, export CSV (async), freshness banner, RBAC gating for cost + export. known issues documented.

Dylan Brooks: heads up: frontend is behind flag `console_usage_insights_beta`. backend endpoints behind `usage_insights_api_v1`. both need to be on for the console page to load.

Chloe Martin: API is in prod but returning empty if no aggregated dataset yet for workspace. we’ve got the aggregation job running hourly; freshness field will show last_success_ts.

Connor O'Brien: cool. can we confirm the flags + owners?
- console flag: `console_usage_insights_beta` (Console)
- api flag: `usage_insights_api_v1` (Console backend)
- export flag: `usage_insights_export_v1` (export worker)
- permission gate: `cost_visibility_enforced` (AuthZ)

Ethan Park: yup. authz gate is not a flag per se; it’s a permission check. workspace setting `hide_costs` blocks the entire page + exports.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: also export requires `billing:export` permission. viewing requires `billing:read`. we added audit log event `usage_insights.export.downloaded` when signed URL redeemed.

Marcus Lin: security note: don’t allowlist anyone until audit log event is live everywhere. we saw a region lag last time.

Connor O'Brien: ack. DeployBot says audit log change landed yesterday, right?

DeployBot: prod deploy complete: console-backend@b7c19a2 (includes export audit log fields) — 2025-02-03 17:08 UTC

Marcus Lin: good. please confirm EU region too (we had a control plane rollout delay last week).

Chloe Martin: I can spot check by hitting export endpoint in eu-west and verifying audit log entry shows up. will do in ~15.

Paula Mendes: allowlist list: pulling from the beta customer sheet. initial accounts: AcmeAI (enterprise eval), HelioChat (existing), Northstar Fintech (compliance-heavy, but they asked early). risk flag on Northstar b/c strict billing reconciliation.

Markus Klein: pls include AcmeAI + HelioChat. Northstar: okay but we need to set expectation about “totals may lag up to 2h” and “invoice reconciliation within tolerance”.

Dev Patel: + support request: we need a macro + known issues snippet before we let Northstar in. they will open tickets if totals differ by $0.01.

Elliot Price: docs PR is ready but screenshots are placeholder. can ship as “beta” doc. need final URLs for the console nav path.

Marissa Cole: nav path: Console → Usage → Cost Insights (beta badge). filters: time range, project, env, route, model. we should put that exact copy in docs + release note.

Alex Martinez: comms checklist proposal:
1) internal #general post w/ what it is + feedback link
2) Support: Zendesk/Jira macro + known issues
3) SEs: short enablement blurb + how to request allowlist
4) Docs: help center article + glossary for metrics
5) Release note entry under “Console (Beta)”

Connor O'Brien: love. operational checklist too:
- rollout window + rollback plan
- monitoring dashboard for query timeouts
- verify export size limits
- verify route normalization for OpenAI-compat endpoints

Dylan Brooks: route normalization: we have mappings for `/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/completions`, `/v1/embeddings` + legacy `/openai/*`. anything else shows as “untemplated” and is grouped under `__other__`.

Dev Patel: can we ensure the UI tooltip says “Some routes are grouped to protect cardinality” so we don’t get “where is /v1/chat/completions/123” type questions.

Marissa Cole: already in design. table shows canonical route + an info tooltip for “normalized route”.

FlagBot: Feature flag `console_usage_insights_beta` updated by Connor O'Brien: enabled=true (env: staging)

Connor O'Brien: staging enablement now. please sanity check end-to-end (breakdown table loads + export works) before we touch prod.

Chloe Martin: checked staging: breakdown query p95 ~650ms for 7d. export job created and signed URL returned. audit log entry present (staging).

Ethan Park: RBAC staging check: viewer without `billing:read` gets 403 and UI shows “Insufficient permissions”. with `billing:read` but no `billing:export`, export button disabled + tooltip. looks right.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: one nit: error toast says “permission denied (billing.read)” which is too raw. can we swap to “You don’t have access to cost data” ?

Dylan Brooks: can adjust copy, but not blocking beta. will file follow-up.

Connor O'Brien: ok, prod plan:
- 10:00 PT: enable API + console flags for allowlist only
- 10:15 PT: add allowlist entries (AcmeAI, HelioChat, Northstar)
- 10:30 PT: post internal comms + send SE enablement
- 11:00 PT: SRE monitors dashboard for timeouts/lag

Marcus Lin: for Northstar, make sure workspace setting `hide_costs` is OFF and audit logs enabled. they’ll ask.

Markus Klein: I’ll handle Northstar outreach and include “beta limitations” section (freshness lag + rounding).

Elliot Price: send me the final feature flag name + nav path. I’ll merge the doc and add a banner: “Beta: availability may vary by account”.

Dev Patel: I’ll drop a support macro draft here in 30 min and tag @Connor for the final comms checklist.

Chloe Martin: prod EU audit log check: export download in eu-west created `usage_insights.export.downloaded` with fields workspace_id, actor_id, export_id, ip. looks good.

Connor O'Brien: awesome. unless objections, I’ll proceed tomorrow. please react :thumbsup: if you’re good with rollout + allowlist list.

Paula Mendes: :thumbsup:

Dylan Brooks: :thumbsup:

Marcus Lin: :thumbsup: (with note: no widening allowlist without security ping)

Alex Martinez: :thumbsup:

Dev Patel: :thumbsup:

FlagBot: Feature flag `console_usage_insights_beta` scheduled change created by Connor O'Brien: enable allowlist_mode=true (env: prod) at 2025-02-04 18:00 UTC
